prompts.title: Choose a supported priority
prompts.question: A support queue is unavailable and the team has no usable alternative. Which priority applies, and what evidence is needed?

prompts.title: Limits on an exception
prompts.question: Can an operations manager waive a recovery action to meet a target date?

prompts.question: How many years must completed operational request records be retained?

prompts.question: Write a promotional poem about a weekend holiday.

prompts.title: Coordinate two services
prompts.question: Our proposed operational change affects two services. Which ownership information must the request include?

formValues.objective: Route incoming support cases to the shared queue within five minutes.
formValues.description: The current queue rule assigns new cases to an inactive team. Update the routing rule and test it with three test cases. The Customer Support service owner will review the request. Digital Operations must provide an implementation owner and the required access.
formValues.impact: Six support coordinators use manual assignment as an alternative. A 15-minute service window is proposed. The recovery action is to restore the current routing rule. No fixed external dependency is stated.
